_comment: TASK-115 batch h7 -- the H7 family (editor GUI state) against projects/_exercises/ex_editor. Refutes the register's 'structurally unreachable' inference for the reachable half (selection, Output panel, run bar, addon list, test-report bridge, screenshot diff) and measures the boundary the rest really have (the 5 editor_simulate_* tools stay out: they inject input into the EDITOR process, which D59 / GDR-21 excludes). Every write is paired with a content-level read-back: editor_get_selection, editor_get_output_log, editor_execute_gdscript (is_playing_scene), project_get_settings, project_get_filesystem_tree.

readback.why: the Output panel of THIS editor process is readable in-process, and after the clear the engine's own log no longer holds the startup lines it held before it (count 10 -> 1 empty line)
the editor's own EditorSelection really answers with the node the tool selected
after the clear the editor's own EditorSelection really is empty, while the same reader had answered a non-empty list earlier in the run
the addon the tool disabled and enabled again is the one ProjectSettings really lists as enabled
after the rescan the project's own filesystem tree still answers with the scene it swept
the editor's own run bar reports playing after the tool answered playing:true, and reports not playing after the matching stop
after the stop the editor's own run bar reports is_playing_scene() == false
